name: Beacon
description: A beacon sweeping: a wedge of light against a banded ground.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: linear-gradient(@pick(45deg, 135deg), @stripe(#0000 20%, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)), #0000 80%)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 50%, 100% 18%, 100% 82%); clip-path: polygon(50% 50%, 100% 18%, 100% 82%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
